scale.note: Stratified sample of the 252-leaf corpus (tests/scale-benchmark/corpus-sampler.mjs, seed 42); the sampler's stratum floors cap the draw at 247, so the 500 and 1000 size rows measure the same corpus. Figures from docs/reports/phase-7-scale-results.json (2026-09-26 run); re-verified by tests/tuning/scale-guard.test.mjs.

guardrails.note: Floors re-derived from this file's benchmark and scale blocks (any measured drop below a floor is a regression). maxFallbackRate is the optimizer's hard constraint (src/tuning/optimizer.mjs:136); thresholdBounds are the optimizer's grid ranges; accuracyTolerancePp is tune-guard's tolerance for weight-change predictions (src/cli/tune-guard.mjs:19). The accuracy floors are strict because the 7.5 scale decision is that BM25 has not yet broken at the corpus ceiling: 0.7843 is the ceiling figure, not a known-good value to protect by margin.

measuredBy: optimizeThresholds() on the 500-skill corpus (Sub-Phase 7.5, result in data/thresholds.json)
